title: At the Back of the North Wind
sourceTitle: At the Back of the North Wind
author: George MacDonald
description: "At the Back of the North Wind" by George MacDonald is a children's fantasy book serialized beginning in 1868 and published in 1871.
longDescription: It follows a sweet boy named Diamond who befriends the mysterious Lady North Wind, a goddess-like being. Together they fly through the nights on magical adventures that help Diamond understand her true nature.

rating.sourceTitle: At the Back of the North Wind

authorInfo.bio: George MacDonald was a Scottish author, poet and Congregational minister. He became a pioneering figure in the field of modern fantasy literature and the mentor of fellow-writer Lewis Carroll. In addition to his fairy tales, MacDonald wrote several works of Christian theology, including several collections of sermons.
